label: Internal structure trend (internal 5, swing 50)
gloss: the direction of the internal structure's latest break, over pivots of length 5, unless the level is also the swing level of length 50 — a state held between breaks, absent before the first break the bars prove — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

confluenceFilter.description: Whether an internal structure break also needs LuxAlgo’s confluence bar test.
